verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a hosted REST API for running AI-powered browser tasks (smooth-docs-20, smooth-docs-13), with task list and cancel endpoints (smooth-docs-37, smooth-docs-38). Results are retrieved by polling, which the docs explicitly choose over webhooks (smooth-docs-36); polling alone satisfies the story. The browser runs on Smooth's infrastructure rather than the user's machine (smooth-comm-11), so the agent manages no browser itself. Missing for 10: no webhook delivery option, no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), no independent hands-on corroboration of the HTTP submit/poll flow.
